gcp._note: interconnect_type='dedicated' and bandwidth='10Gbps' (derived from link_type=LINK_TYPE_ETHERNET_10G_LR, per resources.py::Interconnect's docstring: bandwidth is deliberately free-text since providers report it in genuinely different units). location is the colocation-facility name only, not a full InterconnectLocation self_link -- InterconnectLocation is not one of this contract's 21 canonical resource types (it's static metadata about a facility, not a per-customer resource), so its richer detail (city, address, facility_provider) stays uncaptured here rather than inventing a 22nd resource type. redacted=true is permanent, matching this resource's Partner-Interconnect-adjacent InterconnectAttachment sibling.
